mapper.select: SELECT ROLE FROM T_USER WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{userId} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE RATING = 'UP') AS UP_COUNT ,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE RATING = 'DOWN') AS DOWN_COUNT ,ROUND(AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(TOOLS_USED, '')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(COALESCE(TOOLS_USED, ''), '(', ''))), 1) AS AVG_TOOLS FROM T_AI_CHAT_LOG WHERE 1=1

SELECT TRIM(M.MATCH[1]) AS TOOL_NAME ,COUNT(*) AS USE_COUNT FROM T_AI_CHAT_LOG L CROSS JOIN LATERAL REGEXP_MATCHES(L.TOOLS_USED, '(?:^|\), )([^()]+?) \(', 'g') AS M(MATCH) WHERE 1=1 AND L.TOOLS_USED IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TRIM(M.MATCH[1]) ORDER BY USE_COUNT DESC

SELECT D.DAY::DATE AS STAT_DATE ,COUNT(L.ID) AS CHAT_COUNT ,COUNT(L.ID) FILTER (WHERE L.RATING = 'UP') AS UP_COUNT ,COUNT(L.ID) FILTER (WHERE L.RATING = 'DOWN') AS DOWN_COUNT FROM GENERATE_SERIES(CURRENT_DATE - 6, CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1 day') AS D(DAY) LEFT JOIN T_AI_CHAT_LOG L ON DATE(L.INS_DAY) = D.DAY::DATE WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY D.DAY ORDER BY D.DAY
